patterns.guide: Do not put process jargon in shipped paths (README, user docs, commits, PR bodies).
Reference kit docs by a path resolved from the install manifest, not by climbing out of the project. A relative link to a sibling checkout breaks for everyone who installed the kit somewhere else.
Strip assistant attribution from anything shipped — commit messages, PR bodies, changelogs, docs. Authorship belongs to the person who signed off.
mapfile and readarray are bash 4 builtins; macOS ships bash 3.2, where the line silently reads nothing. Use a read loop or `sed -n`.

sensor_patterns.guide: Run verification in a new agent session, not in the writer session.
Working notes under .ai/ are for the session, not the repository. Commit only what the project agreed to keep (lessons, tracker config).
A skill that names a package, flag, or API must be checked against the upstream source, not recalled. Declare the claim under metadata.verify.
